# wso2is_oauth2_issuer_usage_scope (Resource)

Manages which organizations may use the root organization's token issuer. The resource only changes the settings that you set. Other settings keep their current values. When you destroy this resource, the settings keep their current values, and Terraform stops managing them. Each tenant (or organization) has one set of these settings. To import them, use the ID `oauth2_issuer_usage_scope`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_oauth2_issuer_usage_scope" "this" {
  usage_scope = "ALL_EXISTING_AND_FUTURE_ORGS"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `usage_scope` (String) `ALL_EXISTING_AND_FUTURE_ORGS` or `NONE`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `oauth2_issuer_usage_scope`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_oauth2_issuer_usage_scope.this oauth2_issuer_usage_scope
```
